log:
FluentMusic v1.3.7 Studio Overhaul:
- Studio-grade Apple Music Lyrics Engine powered by flutter_lyric (01/Float preset with distance optical blur and zero text jitter)
- Impeller Vulkan engine force-enabled in AndroidManifest for real optical refraction and specular dispersion
- Eliminated nested glass anti-pattern in MiniPlayer, restoring full Liquid Glass shaders and performance
- Global Light Mode contrast overhaul: all headers, tiles, subtitles, cards and player controls dynamically adapt to dark/light brightness
- Settings screen navigation overhaul: subpages push fullscreen with hidesBottomBarWhenPushed, eliminating duplicate back buttons and tab highlight desync
- Removed buggy scroll listener that collapsed the bottom navigation bar into a gear button
